WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2024-08-01' AS august_start,
           DATE '2024-08-31' AS august_end,
           DATE '2024-09-01' AS september_start,
           DATE '2024-09-30' AS september_end
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
sales_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date,
           s.region,
           f.gross_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT s.region,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.business_date BETWEEN p.august_start AND p.august_end THEN s.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.business_date BETWEEN p.september_start AND p.september_end THEN s.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024
FROM sales_lines s
CROSS JOIN params p
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY s.region;

SELECT DISTINCT store_id, region, valid_from, valid_to
FROM dim_store
WHERE store_id IN (101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 114)
ORDER BY store_id, valid_from;

SELECT s.region, COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY s.region;
